Long uncached inputs with short outputs: no speculation cut median complete-request time 5.37% and 4.53% against MTP3, and 8.75% and 6.62% against the launcher's DFlash5 recipe; both pairs pass their respective separated-range gates. Ready memory fell by about 4.5 GiB versus MTP3 and 6.2-6.3 GiB versus DFlash5. Cached short requests and forced 512-token outputs are slower under both controls. The MTP3 run is the only valid complete measurement for that comparison: an earlier complete run was invalidated by screen-off (Modern Standby) periods in three of four arms (+5.13% separated, +0.84% not separated, 3.51% drift) and is retained, not scored. Quality passed only under the post-hoc non-inferiority rule; the strict rule fails identically in all arms on en-US spelling. Explicit launch only; balanced default, launcher catalog and installed runtime unchanged.
